title: Interactive Sand
tagline: Shape the surface. Reveal the story.
shortDescription: Visitors dig, pile, and shape real sand while a projection follows every move: mountains turn green, valleys fill with water, and hidden fossils or treasures appear where hands uncover them.
longDescription: A sand table that combines the feel of real sand with live projection. A depth sensor reads the shape of the surface and the projection reacts in real time, painting contour lines, water, and landscapes onto the sand, or revealing objects, bones, and stories as visitors dig. It invites slow, hands-on discovery for children and adults alike and works for several people around the table at once. Projected worlds, hidden content, colours, sounds, and the table size are configurable. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: Hands in the Sand
highlights.description: Real sand is irresistible to touch, so visitors of every age start playing without instructions and stay far longer than at a screen.

highlights.title: Learning by Digging
highlights.description: Contour lines, rivers, and layers show how landscapes form, and excavations reveal what lies beneath, making geography, history, or science tangible.

highlights.title: Room for Everyone
highlights.description: Several visitors play around the table together, building and discovering side by side, which turns it into a natural meeting point.

highlights.title: Hidden Layers
highlights.description: Add an excavation challenge against the clock, a flood that visitors hold back with dams, hidden logos or codes that unlock a reward, or a story that changes with the landscape visitors build.

highlights.title: Worlds to Uncover
highlights.description: Dig for dinosaur bones in a natural history museum, uncover ancient pottery in an archaeology exhibition, build islands in a family zone, or reveal products and their origins at a brand stand.

highlights.title: See How Visitors Explore
highlights.description: Add a data layer that counts sessions, play time, and discoveries per hidden object, showing which content visitors uncover and how long the table holds their attention.

highlights.title: Part of the Expedition
highlights.description: Pair with Trail / Scavenger Hunt to make the table one stop of a quest, with Visitor Identificator to save each visitor's finds, or with Spatial Mediaguide to continue the story on the visitor's phone.
